title: Belonging without performance
subtitle: For the heart that needs nearness, not another stage
description: These readings bring the lonely or self-conscious heart into sangat where belonging is learned through remembrance, humility, and shared direction.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Sangat gives the heart a place to be turned toward Naam without performing worthiness.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Seek company that makes remembrance easier and self-display less necessary.

evidence.coreClaim: This path frames belonging as nearness that forms the heart, not attention that flatters it.
evidence.turn: The heart belongs more deeply when it is allowed to remember with others.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one gathering, call, or shared practice that turns you toward Naam.
